annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.every: Every 10,000 miles or 1 year on newer models (older models about 5,000 miles)
maint.note: Use synthetic oil that meets the VW spec for your engine (502.00, 504.00 or 508.00). Diesels need the diesel spec.
Add $100–250 in parts if the rotors also need replacing. GTI and Golf R brakes cost more.
2022 and newer cars with an electronic parking brake need a scan tool to retract the rear calipers.
Newer Golfs need the new battery registered to the car with a scan tool. The e-Golf also has a 12V battery.

maint.every: About every 60,000 miles on 2015+ turbo engines; check the manual for older engines
maint.note: Not needed on TDI diesels or the e-Golf. Coils are often replaced with plugs on high-mileage turbo engines.

maint.job: Engine coolant drain and refill (VW G12/G13 type)
maint.every: Check the owner's manual; a common guide is every 30,000 miles or 5 years, and long-life VW coolant often lasts longer
maint.note: Use only VW-approved coolant; mixing types can cause sludge.
